articles.title: Phillies pitcher Jesús Luzardo is playing it ‘smart’ by not playing through his nagging shoulder stiffness
articles.description: The Phillies have no plans to place Luzardo on the 15-day injured list as they're hoping that rest will help clear up the stiffness, enabling him to start next week.

articles.title: Phillies-Braves ‘cat and mouse game’ has big implications this weekend
articles.description: These teams just met four days ago. They'll face off again now thanks to a scheduling quirk — with a four-game gap between them.

articles.title: Phillies scratch Jesús Luzardo from Saturday’s start vs. Atlanta Braves
articles.description: The Phillies instead will go with a bullpen game for Saturday's matchup with the NL East-leading Atlanta Braves.

articles.title: Phillies miss chance to keep pace in NL East, fall to Astros after Jhoan Duran surrenders ninth-inning homer
articles.description: The second homer of the season against Duran wasted a gutsy effort from Zack Wheeler, who went seven innings and threw 110 pitches.

articles.title: Kyle Schwarber’s grand slam caps off a big sixth inning in Phillies’ win over Astros: ‘It’s incredible’
articles.description: Cristopher Sánchez had an atypical start, allowing six runs and 10 hits in six innings, but Schwarber and the Phillies' offense kept chipping away and exploded for six runs in the sixth.

articles.title: Phillies prospect Aidan Miller moves up to double A in his return from injury
articles.description: After playing one game at single-A Clearwater, Miller was starting at shortstop for Reading on Tuesday. A back condition had kept him out since spring training.

articles.title: ‘If you were in a stadium, you were a target’: Larry Bowa, Hugh Douglas, Doug Glanville recall 9/11 in Philadelphia
articles.description: None of them had a direct connection to the victims, but all of them remain shaken by the day and its aftermath.

articles.title: Phillies minor league director Luke Murton on Aidan Miller, the state of the farm system, and more
articles.description: With the minor league season winding down, Phillies farm director Luke Murton discusses the state of the system, upcoming changes to his role and offers an update on injured top prospect Aidan Miller.

articles.title: Phillies see chance at catching Atlanta’s NL East lead dwindle following 10-run loss to Braves
articles.description: The Braves had scored eight runs in the fourth inning, with seven of those runs coming while they sat with two outs.

articles.description: The Phillies and Braves are set to square off again this weekend in Atlanta, so it’s the perfect time to check in with Jeff Francoeur, who played for both teams and calls Braves games on TV and radio.

articles.description: This next week and a half is as much about setting a tone as it is about winning the NL East or securing a first-round playoff bye.
